items.title: New Kali Tool llm-tools-nmap Uses Nmap For Network Scanning Capabilities
items.description: Along with the release of Kali Linux 2025.3, a major update introduces an innovative tool that combines artificial intelligence and cybersecurity: the llm-tools-nmap. A new experimental plugin, llm-tools-nmap, has been released, providing Simon Willison’s command-line Large Language Model (LLM) tool with network scanning capabilities. This package integrates the powerful and widely used Nmap…
